answer_text: MFA tokens are valid in a 30-second time window (they’re not valid for a fixed moment, but for that 30‑second window). Administrators can configure the MFA token validity period, and during that period the user won’t be prompted for MFA. Users can mark a device as trusted by selecting “Don’t ask me again on this device,” which designates the device as trusted and suppresses prompts until the configured window expires.
